clean.title: Turn Bay Transition - Single Double Centerline
clean.summary: Layout of a turn bay transition where a single centerline shifts into a double centerline. The transition is 45 m (150 ft) long, with a 27 m (90 ft) straight 30:1 taper from point A to point B, followed by curves that offset the line 1.5 m (5 ft) on one side and 3 m (10 ft) on the other. A six-step layout procedure using points A to J gives the striping geometry.
clean.notes:
Dimensions (metric with US customary in parentheses):
Start of transition to end of transition: 45 m (150').
30:1 taper from point A to point B: 27 m (90').
Then segments of 3 m (10'), 3 m (10'), 6 m (20'), 3 m (10'), 3 m (10').
Offset from centerline of street: 1.5 m (5') on one side and 3 m (10') on the other.
Points A to J are labeled along the centerline of street.
Procedure to install transition
1. Layout points A, D, G, & H.
2. Use points A & D to determine a straight line and mark B & C.
3. Use points C & G to determine a straight line and mark E & F.
4. Mark J by measuring 180 mm (7") in from C. Mark I by measuring 150 mm (6") in from G.
5. Form curves B-J-E & F-I-H.
6. Stripe.

clean.title: Speed Humps and Speed Cushions
clean.summary: Pasadena standard for installing 3.5 inch asphalt speed humps and speed cushions, with installation notes, warning sign and temporary signing requirements. Separate sheets give hump layouts for streets under 50 ft wide and 50 ft or wider, and cushion layouts for streets 28 ft to 38 ft and 38 ft and greater. Humps are 12 ft long in the direction of travel with a 3.5 inch nominal height, built of Type D2 PG 64-10 asphalt, and marked with thermoplastic. A W17-1 SPEED HUMP sign and a flashing barricade with W8-1 or W17-1 and W13-1 signs are required until the pavement markings are in place.
clean.notes:
Installation details
1. Speed humps shall not be placed over manholes, watergates, junction chambers, etc.
2. Edge of speed hump should be 10 ft minimum from edge and uphill of driveway.
3. Height of speed hump shall nominally be 3.5 in +/- 0.25 in at all cross sections.
4. Whenever possible, speed humps shall be placed at property lines instead of mid-lot.
5. Whenever possible, speed humps shall be placed adjacent to street lights.
6. Speed humps shall be marked using thermoplastic material.
7. Speed hump signs shall be installed per Figure A, where noted on plans.

Figure A: Speed hump warning sign (typical)
Warning flags (first 30 days). 30 in x 30 in, black on yellow, W17-1 "SPEED HUMP", 6 in Series E letters.
Sign locations: as directed by Engineer.

Temporary signage details
1. The contractor shall furnish and maintain a flashing barricade, 50 ft from each speed hump location in both directions, until the first application of paint has been applied showing the pavement messages and striping.
2. Mount 30 in x 30 in W8-1 or W17-1 warning sign (black on yellow, 6 in Series E letters) and W13-1 sign per MUTCD with the California Supplement, on each of the barricades at each speed hump location.

Speed hump/cushion installation channelization/temporary signing requirements. Sheet 1 of 5.

clean.title: Crosswalk Installation
clean.summary: Pasadena standard layouts for marked crosswalks, covering the basic crosswalk, the zebra crosswalk and the continental crosswalk. All striping is 12 in white or yellow thermoplastic or similar material. Bar spacing starts from the street center line and avoids the wheel path, and bars are parallel to traffic flow at skewed or offset intersections. Continental bars are 2 ft wide and 14 ft long, and a 12 in white limit line is typically used only in advance of signalized intersections.

Continental crosswalk. Sheet 3 of 3.

2. Start of first bar shall be centered to the DYCL, avoiding wheel path. Continental crosswalk "bars" shall meet edge of gutter. For skewed or offset intersections, all crosswalk "bars" shall be parallel to flow of traffic, in thermoplastic or similar materials.

For crosswalk layout, refer to sheet 1 of 3.

clean.title: Layout, 3 m (10 ft) Wide Turn Bay Transition
clean.summary: Pasadena layout for striping a 3 m (10 ft) wide turn bay transition. A five-step procedure establishes points A through H, locating the straight lines and forming the two curves. The diagram is dimensioned for a 27 m (90 ft) transition, using 4.5 m (15 ft) and 9 m (30 ft) segments, with values in brackets for an 18 m (60 ft) transition using 3 m (10 ft) and 6 m (20 ft) segments.
clean.notes:
Layout 3 m [10 ft] wide turn bay transition. Sheet 1 of 1.
Diagram: start of transition to end of transition, with segments of 4.5 m (15 ft), 4.5 m (15 ft), 9 m (30 ft), 4.5 m (15 ft), 4.5 m (15 ft). For the 18 m (60 ft) transition, use the figures in brackets: 3 m (10 ft), 3 m (10 ft), 6 m (20 ft), 3 m (10 ft), 3 m (10 ft).
Procedure to install transition
1. Lay out points A, B, E and F.
2. Use points B and E to determine a straight line and mark C and D.
3. Mark G and H by measuring in 190 mm (7 1/2 in) perpendicular to lines A-B and E-F (for 27 m (90 ft) and 18 m (60 ft) transitions).
4. Form curves A-G-C and D-H-F.
5. Stripe.
For 18 m (60 ft) transition, use figures in parentheses shown on diagram and proceed with steps 1 through 5.

clean.title: STOP Sign and Post Replacement
clean.summary: Pasadena detail for replacing a STOP sign and its post. A 760 mm (30 in) high intensity R1-1 STOP sign is mounted on a 3.0 m (10 ft) long galvanized square tube post that slides into a 610 mm (24 in) long galvanized anchor tube driven about 1.0 m (3 ft) into the ground. The sheet gives tube sizes, hole and rivet sizes, and concrete or consolidated backfill requirements, with a concrete sidewalk sloped to drain.
clean.notes:
STOP sign and post replacement. Sheet 1 of 1.
Section A-A: 11 mm (7/16 in) dia. hole in each tube for 9.5 mm (3/8 in) rivet. 50 mm (2 in) dimension.
Detail: 760 mm (30 in) high intensity R1-1 STOP sign. 11 mm (7/16 in) hole with 9.5 mm (3/8 in) rivet. Galvanized 62.5 mm (2 1/2 in) O.D. square tube (12 gauge), 3.0 m (10 ft) long, ASTM A446. Galvanized 75 mm (3 in) O.D. square anchor tube, 610 mm (24 in) long, wall thickness 5 mm (3/16 in), ASTM A500 Grade B. Drive 1.0 m (3 ft) into ground. Plug end of anchor tube to exclude concrete. Tamped backfill typical. 305 mm (12 in) minimum to 455 mm (18 in) maximum dimension shown on the sheet.
Notes
1. Concrete shall comply with the latest edition of the Standard Specifications for Public Works Construction.
2. Concrete may be premixed, sacked concrete or field proportioned cement and aggregate with water added and mixing occurring on the job site. 2% calcium chloride (by weight of cement) may be added to produce a quickset concrete.
3. Consolidated backfill or concrete sidewalk, slope to drain.

clean.title: STOP Sign Post Extension for Street Name Signs Installation
clean.summary: Pasadena detail for adding a street name sign extension to an existing STOP sign post. A 57 mm (2 1/4 in) O.D. galvanized square steel tube extension with 12 gauge wall (3 mm, 0.118 in) is attached with 9.5 mm (3/8 in) drive rivets through 11 mm (7/16 in) holes, 4 places in the post and 3 places in the extension. Salvaged street name signs and brackets are remounted, and new stainless steel strap and buckle (15 mm x 0.75 mm) secures them to the tube extension or street light standard.
clean.notes:
STOP sign post extension (for street name signs). Sheet 1 of 1.
57 mm (2 1/4 in) O.D. square steel tube extension, wall thickness of 12 gauge [3 mm (0.118 in)], galvanized.
11 mm (7/16 in) diam. holes for 9.5 mm (3/8 in) drive rivets (typical): 4 places in post, 3 places in extension.
Salvaged street name signs and brackets (typical). Existing mounting holes on STOP sign post.
New stainless steel strap and buckle, 15 mm x 0.75 mm (5/8 in x 0.03 in), for tube extension or street light standard.
